guides.title: Ship a tested mobile feature with the right update path

setup: Open the Expo project, record its SDK and dependencies, and select the target device or simulator.

Implement the feature using the project’s data and UI patterns.
Run component checks and the target-device walkthrough.

guides.name: Formula Genius
guides.title: Build a spreadsheet formula that survives edge cases

setup: Identify Excel or Google Sheets, its version and locale, and the cells involved.

Generate or repair the formula.
Check normal, blank, duplicate, and boundary cases with expected results.
Place the formula in the intended workbook and inspect the surrounding totals or references.
checks: The formula matches the supplied expected results.
Separators, functions, and references work in the target application.

guides.name: Wolfram
guides.title: Check a quantitative result with reproducible computation
guides.summary: Evaluate equations, units, data, or optimization questions and keep the inputs and assumptions attached to the result.
setup: State the mathematical question, units, assumptions, and required precision.
steps: Retrieve the relevant computational context.
Formulate the calculation with explicit units and assumptions.
Evaluate it with Wolfram|Alpha or Wolfram Language.
Check limiting cases, dimensional consistency, or an independent numerical example.
checks: Units and domains are consistent.
A boundary or independent calculation agrees within the stated tolerance.
guides.starter_prompt: Use Wolfram to check a quantitative result with reproducible computation. Start from the inputs I provide, follow the setup and workflow, and return computed result, reusable expression, assumptions and validation. Verify: Units and domains are consistent. A boundary or independent calculation agrees within the stated tolerance.
guides.when_to_use: Evaluate equations, units, data, or optimization questions and keep the inputs and assumptions attached to the result.
requirements: State the mathematical question, units, assumptions, and required precision.

guides.name: Prompt Injection Security
guides.title: Test whether untrusted content can redirect an assistant
guides.summary: Examine documents, retrieved passages, tool results, and memory for paths that could change an assistant’s authorized behavior.
setup: Use a test environment with a defined task, tool permissions, and synthetic sensitive values.
steps: Map where untrusted text enters the workflow and which actions it could influence.
Create controlled cases that attempt to override the task or misuse a tool.
Record whether each case changes the output or triggers an unauthorized operation.
Apply input handling or action-boundary fixes and repeat both normal and adversarial cases.
checks: Untrusted content cannot authorize a new destination or action.
Normal tasks still succeed after the mitigation.
guides.starter_prompt: Use Prompt Injection Security to test whether untrusted content can redirect an assistant. Start from the inputs I provide, follow the setup and workflow, and return injection test cases, boundary findings, mitigation regression results. Verify: Untrusted content cannot authorize a new destination or action. Normal tasks still succeed after the mitigation.
guides.when_to_use: Examine documents, retrieved passages, tool results, and memory for paths that could change an assistant’s authorized behavior.
requirements: Use a test environment with a defined task, tool permissions, and synthetic sensitive values.

workflows.title: Build, review, and finish a feature
steps: Resume the project with Atlas Continuum and select the required connection with Atlas Omnium.
Use Superpowers and Codex Dev Workflows to reproduce the problem or implement the bounded feature.
Use Promptfoo when the feature depends on model output; use Endor Labs when dependencies or security findings are affected.
Review the change, run its relevant tests, and save the working result and next handoff.
checks: The requested behavior works and the original failure stays fixed.
The delivered revision matches the recorded verification.

workflows.title: Make a useful product easy to find
inputs: Audience, locale, and important user journeys
steps: Use Brand Strategist to state the product promise and useful reasons to choose it.
Use Keyword Tool to map relevant search intent to useful pages.
Use OpenSEO and AIOScan to find concrete crawl, metadata, content, and access issues.
Use Product Design to verify that visitors can find the feature and complete the intended journey.
Recheck the changed pages and retain the resulting audit links.
checks: Titles and descriptions accurately describe each page.
Both the crawler checks and the user journey succeed.

workflows.title: Build and evaluate a knowledge assistant
steps: Use Hugging Face to select suitable model and dataset candidates.
Use RAG & GenAI Copilot to define ingestion, retrieval, citations, and update behavior.
Use Promptfoo to compare retrieval-backed answers on normal, unanswerable, and known failure cases.
Use Prompt Injection Security to test untrusted-document and tool-boundary cases.
Use DEEPBOM when the selected deployment includes an inspectable model artifact.
checks: Answers cite passages that support them.
Restricted or malicious content cannot redirect authorized behavior.

workflows.title: Deliver trustworthy data and dashboards
steps: Use SQL Expert to align schema and constraints with the application.
Use SQL Copilot to verify joins, time boundaries, nulls, and aggregates on a small fixture.
Use PlanetScale or WoWSQL for the project’s actual database.
Use Preset to build the dashboard from the verified metrics.
Use Formula Genius when stakeholders also need a spreadsheet calculation or reconciliation.
checks: Dashboard and workbook totals agree with the reference data.
Each viewer can access exactly the intended records.

workflows.title: Build and verify a mobile experience
steps: Use Expo to implement the feature with the correct native and navigation requirements.
Use Testing React Native Apps for component behavior and device interaction.
Use Test Android Apps for the Android flow and any measured performance issue.
Use Product Design to inspect the complete flow, accessible controls, and screen layouts.
Verify the resulting build or update on the target platform.
checks: Loading, success, and failure states work in the component and on the device.
The intended user journey completes on every selected platform.

workflows.title: Design a coherent product experience
steps: Use Brand Strategist to settle the product promise and voice.
Use Pablooo.club to compare relevant interface patterns.
Use Product Design and Designly to define an original interface and consistent art direction.
Use MagicPath for components and Wixel for the selected visual assets.
Inspect the assembled experience and verify its key interaction on the intended screen sizes.
checks: The primary action is obvious and usable.
Layout, typography, and brand treatment remain consistent across the finished experience.

workflows.title: Choose and measure a model deployment
steps: Use Hugging Face to choose candidates and record their exact revisions.
Use DEEPBOM to inspect available deployment artifacts.
Use Promptfoo to establish a quality baseline.
Use NVIDIA or AMD workflows for the actual hardware and Modal when the chosen workload needs cloud compute.
Compare the same quality and performance cases after each focused change.
checks: Performance gains preserve the required output quality.
Results record the model, hardware, runtime, and workload.

workflows.title: Review access, dependencies, and agent boundaries
steps: Use Descope to examine sign-in, permissions, and tenant boundaries.
Use Endor Labs to inspect dependency and code findings.
Use Prompt Injection Security for assistant and retrieval boundaries.
Use Authorised OSINT Toolkit for relevant public exposure and reverse engineering anything for supplied software artifacts.
Fix confirmed issues and repeat the affected normal and negative test cases.
checks: Every finding has a specific target and reproducible evidence.
The remediation closes the failure while retaining intended access and behavior.

workflows.title: Research a question and explain the result
steps: Use TinyFish to find and read relevant primary material.
Use nDot Physics Research for a question about its published physics work.
Use Wolfram to check the quantitative part with explicit assumptions and units.
Use Gum for precise figures and MindMap for a navigable conceptual outline.
Use KaTeX Error Fixer when equations need to appear in a rendered learning page.
checks: Each substantive claim can be traced to its source or calculation.
The rendered equations and figures preserve the verified content.

workflows.title: Create and test a game feature
steps: Use Game Development Studio to create or select and validate the asset.
Use Wixel for any requested visual reference or supporting graphic.
Use Unity Essentials to implement the feature in a reproducible scene.
Use the relevant NVIDIA or AMD workflow when the task specifically depends on that hardware.
Run the scene and intended build and compare both appearance and measured performance.
checks: Assets load correctly and the feature works after reopening the project.
The scene meets the declared visual and performance target.

workflows.title: Organize personal projects and learning
steps: Use MindMap to organize the goal into useful topics and next actions.
Use TinyFish to gather any current facts needed to make a decision.
Use Formula Genius for a tracker or calculation with explicit example rows.
Use Flowchart Maker for a recurring decision or process.
Use Windowisp for an optional Windows focus-session companion.
checks: Every immediate action has the information needed to begin.
Tracker calculations match the supplied examples.

workflows.title: Turn architecture into an editable visual
steps: Choose the view with Diagram Maker: structure, sequence, data, or process.
Use Flowchart Maker for a decision process and Lucid for a shared editable architecture document.
Use Gum when the deliverable needs a precise figure or reproducible export.
Compare every displayed entity and relationship with the actual source.
Review the exported diagram at its intended viewing size.
checks: The diagram answers the stated question without invented relationships.
Labels and connections remain readable in the final export.
